lines.text: The famine was severe in Egypt and Canaan, and Joseph brought all the collected money into Pharaoh's palace.
When the money ran out, Joseph gave the Egyptians food in exchange for their horses, flocks, herds, and donkeys.
In the second year, the Egyptians said only their bodies and land were left, offering to become soldiers for Pharaoh.
Joseph acquired all the land for Pharaoh except the priests' land, because they ate the rations Joseph supplied.
Joseph gave the people seed, and they were to give a fifth of the harvest to Pharaoh and keep four-fifths.
